newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse clears Kruszwica for main mkt trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse clears Kruszwica for main mkt trade.

text.p: The supervisory board of the Warsaw bourse cleared shares in Polish edible-fats maker Zaklady Tluszczowe Kruszwica SA (Kruszwica) for trade on the exchange's main market, the bourse said in a Tuesday statement.
The company, which starts its initial public offering of 1.65 million shares on December 9, earlier set the minimum issue price at 25 zlotys.
The shares will be alloted at the Warsaw bourse on December 23.
Kruszwica made a net profit of 15.8 million zlotys on sales @ of 543.2 million zlotys from January 1 to December 20 of last year, when the firm officially became a joint-stock company.
From December 21 last year to September 30, 1996, it netted seven million zlotys on sales of 351.7 million zlotys.
